stemMd: For a linear function $f$, $f(3)=11$ and $f(7)=23$. What is $f(10)-f(2)$?
explanationMd: The slope is (23−11)/(7−3)=3. For any linear function, the change in output is slope times change in input. Therefore f(10)−f(2)=3(10−2)=24; the intercept cancels.
